sample_unit: rated LLM responses (100 ENT scenarios x 9 questions x 5 models x 2 phases)

links.outcome: Temporal stability of LLM responses across repeated test phases one month apart
links.effect: Temporal stability was greatest in ChatGPT-5 and Gemini-3, with minimal drift between test phases (Δ < 0.1).
links.quote: Temporal stability was greatest in ChatGPT-5 and Gemini-3, with minimal drift between test phases (Δ < 0.1).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the medical knowledge and guideline adherence of five LLMs on 100 standardized ENT clinical scenarios evaluated by expert raters across two time points.
